title: No all-caps text outside the menus
why: His hard rule (2026-10-18): nothing shown to the player is ever in all caps. The text watcher saw only #root, so the attract card, the REC mark and the fps box sat outside it, and tooltips and placeholders were never fixed. It now watches the whole page and fixes title, placeholder and aria-label text. The Taken stamp, the Need chips and the Player 2 tab title are written in sentence case.
now: Tooltips, placeholders and text outside the menus show in sentence case too.

edits.replacement: document.title='Pillagers, player 2';   /* v28.xx (cw-nocaps-dom): never all caps */
